main_text.head: CAP. XXVI.
main_text.p: VOTVPLEX igitur eft dictionū cō-munitas? Duplex.quarum altera eft in vniuerfa dictione, quæ à Dialecti-cis nominatur Synonymia &Homo-nymia: altera in parte,quæ ab iisdem Paronymia dicitur.

·Quæ funt Synonyma? Synonimorum funt alia Dialectica, alia Grammatica. Dialectica funt,quæ generis alicuiusfuperioris & nomē & rationē communem habēt: vt Bos & equus ex fui generis communione & nomen & ra-tionem & definitionem effentialem (de qua posterius intelliges) communē obtinent.Nam vttunque dicitur animal : fed tamen in quali-tate differunt.
- Quæ funt Synonyma Grammatica? Plu-ra vnius eiufdémque rei vocabula: vel,quæ re inter fe conueniunt,fono tantùm difcrepant.

page.notes: The first word of the paragraph beginning "VOTVPLEX" stands after a large decorative woodcut initial that I could not read; the initial may be a Q, and the word may be read differently. Greek word ὁμώνυμα is transcribed as printed, with the accents uncertain. "conueniūt" may carry a different mark over the u. Small ornaments above the subtitle and beside the chapter heading are decoration, not text. The running head is taken from the top of the page; the page number 88 is printed at the top left.
